about: slapstic page 0 $8C00-$93FF: the AT-AT walkers continued - the four animated legs (hip, knee, ankle and foot points made from keyframe tracks and drawn as object $1B), the laser cursor tests on body, head and eye, the destruction, tow cable catch, crash and respawn of a walker, the keyframe rings and track table of the walk cycles and the start of the interpolation routine that pages 0 and 1 share

P0:8C27.name: atat_legs
P0:8C27.desc: draws the four legs of the AT-AT at U, called by atat_view_legs: puts the walk cycle counter (byte $15 of the record) in anim_frame, takes the leg set for byte $16 from atat_gait_tab (set 0 when it is over 2) and calls atat_leg_set with X at the set's four leg record pointers

P0:8C46.name: atat_leg_set
P0:8C46.desc: draws the four legs of one leg set: X points at four pointers to 5-byte leg records, the first two (front legs) go to atat_front_leg and the last two (rear legs) to atat_rear_leg

P0:8C5C.name: atat_front_leg
P0:8C5C.desc: works out and draws one front leg of the AT-AT at U. X points at the pointer to the leg record (first track number, hip x word, hip y word). restarts the perspected points at BJ_PNT and views three points of the hip (atat_front_hip) and three of the knee (atat_knee, which also tests the tow cable). only when the knee is within 45 degrees left and right of straight ahead it marks the walker drawn, sets the brightness or crashes the ship (atat_leg_shade), views the ankle and the foot (atat_ankle_foot) and has bank 1 draw object $1B through the 12 points. ends by storing anim_frame back in byte $15 of the record

P0:8CBA.name: atat_rear_leg
P0:8CBA.desc: works out and draws one rear leg of the AT-AT at U: the same code as atat_front_leg except that the hip points come from atat_rear_hip

P0:8D18.name: atat_leg_shade
P0:8D18.desc: called for a leg whose knee is in view. when the walker's centre (M_XT) is farther than $2000 it writes the colour word for the leg, colour 2 with a brightness of ($4000 - distance, held to 0-$0800) / 16. when the walker is nearer and the knee is less than $0280 ahead of the ship (M_XP) the ship has flown into the leg and atat_crash is called

P0:8D49.name: atat_rear_hip
P0:8D49.desc: hip of a rear leg: with the hip's x and y already in M_X0 and M_Y0 it sets z to 0, adds the offset of the leg's first track (atat_add_track) and views the three points of the joint (atat_joint_pts)

P0:8D55.name: atat_front_hip
P0:8D55.desc: hip of a front leg: as atat_rear_hip but with z $0117 and the three slanted points of atat_fr_hip_pts

P0:8D61.name: atat_add_track
P0:8D61.desc: takes the track number in the first byte of the leg record at X, has anim_track_pos (maze entry P0_85B3) interpolate that track for anim_frame and adds the offset it leaves in anim_dx, anim_dy and anim_dz to the scratch point M_X0, M_Y0, M_Z0

P0:8D82.name: atat_knee
P0:8D82.desc: knee of the leg whose record is at X, hip x and y already in M_X0 and M_Y0: z is half way down the walker's height (word 9 of the record at U) plus $0300, in the half units the leg points use, the offset of the leg's second track is added, the tow cable is tested against the knee (cable_leg_test) and the three points of the joint are viewed (atat_joint_pts)

P0:8DBA.name: atat_ankle_foot
P0:8DBA.desc: ankle and foot of the leg whose record is at X, hip x and y already in M_X0 and M_Y0: the ankle is $0300 above the ground plus the offset of the leg's third track and gives three points (atat_joint_pts), then z is set to the ground plus the track's z offset and the three points of the foot are viewed around the place the ankle's points ended (atat_foot_pts)

P0:8DFD.name: atat_fr_hip_pts
P0:8DFD.desc: views three points around the scratch point for a front hip, each through bank 1 KD9F6 (L60DE) which adds the next perspected point to BJ_PNT: x - $0100 and z - $60, then x + $0100, y + $80 and z + $60, then the same with y - $80. it leaves M_X0, M_Y0 and M_Z0 at the last point

P0:8E3D.name: atat_joint_pts
P0:8E3D.desc: views three points around the scratch point M_X0, M_Y0, M_Z0 for one joint of a leg, each through bank 1 KD9F6 (L60DE): x - $0100, then x + $0100 and y + $80, then x + $0100 and y - $80, all at the same z. it leaves M_X0 and M_Y0 at the last point

P0:8E6B.name: atat_foot_pts
P0:8E6B.desc: views the three points of a foot through bank 1 KD9F6 (L60DE), starting from the last point of the ankle: with the ankle's centre as origin they are x - $0200, then x + $0200 and y + $0100, then x + $0200 and y - $0100, a triangle twice the size of a joint's

P0:8EA2.name: atat_oct_dist
P0:8EA2.desc: octagon distance from the laser cursor (LZ_CX, LZ_CY) to the perspected point at X, as in Star Wars' S2VW and VWGUN hit tests: the larger of the absolute x and y differences or 9/16 of their sum, whichever is greater, less 10, not below 0. returns it in D. page 1 has its own copy, cursor_oct_dist

P0:8EE1.name: atat_body_hit
P0:8EE1.desc: laser cursor test on the body of an AT-AT, called by atat_draw_body after object $17 is drawn. only when the walker (M_XT) is nearer than atat_hit_d: finds the screen size of a length of $02EE at the walker's distance and tests the cursor against the body's perspected points 21 to 24 with atat_oct_dist. when the cursor is on one of them it records the distance in atat_hit_d with atat_hit_rec 0, so a shot stops on the body and destroys nothing, and counts w2_spk_cnt, which starts the speech spk_cmd_03 after 20 such frames in a row and then parks at $80. when it is on none the count starts again

P0:8F64.name: atat_head_hit
P0:8F64.desc: laser cursor test on the head of an AT-AT, called by atat_draw_head after object $18 is drawn. only when the head (M_XT) is nearer than atat_hit_d: finds the screen size of a length of $0271 at the head's distance (less $01F4, at least $01F4) and, when the cursor is within it of perspected point 42, records the distance in atat_hit_d with atat_hit_rec 0, a hit that destroys nothing

P0:8FA6.name: atat_eye_hit
P0:8FA6.desc: laser cursor test on the four-sided figure of the head that object $19 draws (perspected points 38 to 41), the one atat_head_aim turns red, called at the end of atat_head_aim with U at the AT-AT record. when the head (M_XT) is not farther than atat_hit_d and the cursor lies inside the box around the four points, it puts U in atat_hit_rec and the distance in atat_hit_d: this walker is the one a laser shot destroys

P0:9003.name: atat_eye_shot
P0:9003.desc: reached through the maze entry P0_8538 from the laser routine of page 3 (P3_97FA) when the nearest thing under the cursor is the eye of an AT-AT: loads U with atat_hit_rec and falls into atat_destroy

P0:9006.name: atat_destroy
P0:9006.desc: destroys the AT-AT at U, shot in the eye or fallen to the ground (atat_mode_fall): starts the three-piece explosion of bank 1 BGTWXP at the walker's position plus its head offset, frees the tow cable record when the walker was caught by the cable, respawns or frees the record (atat_spawn), holds up the walkers' advance (hold_adv_kill) and scores: 75 points while bonus_left is open and, when this kill closes it, 5000 points, the Jedi letter (page 1 P1_9573) and one more on quota_walker, else 750 points. ends with the sound aud_cmd_51

P0:904E.name: cable_leg_test
P0:904E.desc: tests the tow cable against the knee just worked out in M_X0 and M_Y0 for the AT-AT at U, called by atat_knee. nothing when the walker is already falling or no cable is out (cable_rec 0). the knee's universe x (twice the point's x plus the walker's) must be within $02AA plus the cable's step of this frame (cable_vx) of the cable's end (cable_tx), and the same in y, then cable_catch is called

P0:90A5.name: cable_catch
P0:90A5.desc: the tow cable has caught a leg of the AT-AT at U: moves the cable's end to the knee, holds up the advance (hold_adv_catch), scores as atat_destroy does (75 points and the count down of bonus_left with the 5000 points and Jedi letter when it closes, else 750 points), sets bit 1 of the type byte and movement mode 2 so that the walker falls, and marks the cable attached (P0_9915)

P0:90E5.name: hold_adv_kill
P0:90E5.desc: called when an AT-AT is destroyed: while bonus_left is not 0 adds hold_add to adv_hold, the frames the walkers' advance is held up ($FF at most), and takes 1 off hold_add while it is over 15. the first of three identical copies

P0:9102.name: hold_adv_catch
P0:9102.desc: called when the tow cable catches an AT-AT: the same code as hold_adv_kill

P0:911F.name: hold_adv_legs
P0:911F.desc: called by atat_move_all when the player flies under an AT-AT and the legs bonus is scored: the same code as hold_adv_kill

P0:913C.name: atat_crash
P0:913C.desc: the ship has run into the AT-AT being viewed (record in S2_PRM), called for a leg close in front (atat_leg_shade) and under a falling walker (atat_view_all): replaces the walker's colour word in the display list (atat_col_ptr) with the flash list call $A013 and sets bit 7 of byte 1 so that it is written again next frame, starts the shield hit glow (BG1GLW) and the crash sound aud_cmd_32, and sets the roll from the hit S_ROL to $20, with the sign it already has or, when it is 0, the sign of the high byte of M_YP

P0:9163.name: atat_spawn
P0:9163.desc: puts a new AT-AT in the record at U, called by atat_move_all for a free record and by atat_destroy. when w2_spawn_b is not positive the record is freed instead. a walker that was not drawn this frame restarts half the world ($8000) from the player in x, one that was drawn moves half the world in x or, one time in two, half the world in y with a random x. in the first two cases y gets a random step added, is cut to a multiple of $1000 and gets 0-$03FC added. the height is $2000, the mode 1 (walk), the type $29 and the flags 0. the head angles, the walk cycle counter and the leg set are kept

P0:93B4.name: anim_track_pos
P0:93B4.desc: keyframe interpolation for the legs of the walkers, called through the maze entry P0_85B3 by the AT-AT code of this page and the AT-ST code of page 1. B = track number, anim_frame = frames into the walk cycle. takes the track's starting key from anim_track_tab (track 0 when B is past the table), walks round the ring of 7-byte keys taking each key's frame count off the time, and blends the offsets of the key the time falls in and of the next one by the fraction of the key that has passed, with the divider and the matrix multiply MS_PERS. returns the x, y and z offset in anim_dx, anim_dy and anim_dz. when the walk comes back to the starting key the cycle is over and anim_frame is cleared. leaves the divider's numerator at $0200. the routine runs on to $9471

4C05.name: atat_hit_d
4C05.desc: word: view distance of the nearest part of an AT-AT the laser cursor is on in this frame, written by atat_body_hit, atat_head_hit and atat_eye_hit while the AT-ATs are drawn. the laser start on page 3 (P3_95C9) sets the high byte to $FF for none, and page 3 P3_97CB compares it with the distances of the other things under the cursor (atst_hit_d, CL_GDS) and takes the nearest

4C07.name: atat_hit_rec
4C07.desc: word, goes with atat_hit_d: the record of the AT-AT whose eye the cursor is on, which atat_eye_shot then destroys, or 0 when the nearest hit was on a body or a head and the shot only stops there

4C88.name: anim_start
4C88.desc: word: address of the key the track being interpolated starts its cycle on, kept by anim_track_pos to notice when it has gone once round the ring

4C8A.name: anim_left
4C8A.desc: temp of anim_track_pos: the frames of anim_frame not yet used up by the keys passed, in the end the frames into the key the time falls in

50E6.name: cable_vx
50E6.desc: word in the tow cable's block at M_AL (10 bytes before its position): the x step the cable's end takes each frame, set by the cable launch (P0_95EF) from the cursor's direction. cable_leg_test widens its catch range by its size

50EE.name: cable_vy
50EE.desc: word in the tow cable's block at M_AL: the y step the cable's end takes each frame, as cable_vx

50F8.name: cable_tx
50F8.desc: MS_TX+M_AL: word, universe x of the tow cable's end, first of the position words of its block at M_AL (cable_tz is the third). the cable code moves it by cable_vx each frame, cable_leg_test compares it with the knees of the AT-ATs and cable_catch sets it to the knee caught

50FA.name: cable_ty
50FA.desc: MS_TY+M_AL: word, universe y of the tow cable's end, as cable_tx

questions: the 502 bytes at P0:91BE-P0:93B3 are data for anim_track_pos (P0:93B4): eight rings of 7-byte keyframes (x, y, z offset words and a frame count), each ended by a key with count 0 followed by a 2-byte pointer back to the ring's first key, at $91BE, $91CE, $921D, $926C, $9283, $9293, $92C6 and $92F9, then the 68-word track table at $932C. the keys cannot be shown with the region kinds: only the eight link pointers and the track table are given as ptrs. the pointers of the table and the links point at keys inside the rows, which have no label of their own
P0:926C the ring of two still keys of 6 frames is pointed at by no entry of the track table and by nothing else found: unused
the labels P0_922B and P0_92EE that split rows of the keyframe data are only targets of decoy calls in the maze (P0_81D8, P0_845A), not starts of anything

P0:90A5 and P0:9006 both score and both count bonus_left down, so an AT-AT brought down by the tow cable is scored twice, when the cable catches the leg and again when the walker reaches the ground and blows up. this is what the code does, whether it is intended is not known
P0:90E5, P0:9102 and P0:911F are three identical copies of one routine, each with one caller
P0:91B5 the type byte $29 of a spawned AT-AT: bit 5 lets it shoot and bit 1 is falling, what bits 0 and 3 mean is not shown by any test in this stretch
P0:913C the AVG word $A013 is a JSRL to vector RAM $0026. it is described as the flash list call after atat_view_all (P0:8939), which list is copied there was not checked

P0:9156 when S_ROL is 0 the side of the roll is taken from the high byte of M_YP, whatever point the math box viewed last (the knee for a leg crash, the walker's centre for a crash under a falling walker). the NOP after it looks like a patched out instruction

P0:8F5B which phrase the speech spk_cmd_03 is, was not determined here: it is started when the cursor has been on an AT-AT's body for 20 frames in a row, which fits a hint that lasers do not hurt the body
P0:8EC1, P0:8ED1 and P0:8ED6 show $4803 as a bare operand although the address has the names TMPOCT and TMPSIZ in the defines (P0:8EAD and P0:8EBC use them). no new name given

the perspected point numbers in the comments (21-24 body, 42 head, 38-41 eye) are 5-byte slots of BJ_PNT counted from $4E00, the numbering the bank 1 draw routine of object $19 (KCE19) is commented with. the body's points start at slot 1 and the head's at slot 22 (bank 1 table KD77C)

names taken from the neighbouring stretches and used here without renaming: atat_col_ptr, cable_rec, cable_tz, s1_tx (p0_85ec), anim_frame, anim_dx, anim_dy, anim_dz (p1_8c00), hold_add (p1_9800). atat_hit_d and atat_hit_rec ($4C05, $4C07) are also named, with the same names, by p3_9800. cable_tx, cable_ty, cable_vx and cable_vy are named here from the AT-AT side, the tow cable code at P0_9561 on is outside this stretch
P0:93B4 anim_track_pos runs on to $9471, past the end of this stretch. its lines from $9402 on are not commented here
